verdict.rationale: Anthropic's docs include a standing model-deprecations page, per-model retirement floors on the models overview (e.g. "Not sooner than September 1, 2027"), and an advance-notice deprecation policy with migration guides. Pinned, versioned model IDs let developers stay on a specific model until its documented retirement date. Missing for 10: the exact length of the notice period and the content of the migration guides are not spelled out in the evidence, and no independent or hands-on report confirms that notices actually arrived ahead of a retirement.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on a documented deprecation policy with advance notice and migration guidance before a model I depend on is retired

citations.quote: A standing model-deprecations page plus per-model retirement floors on the models overview
